requirements.requirement: Instantiate initializes Key to 0x00 and V to 0x01 at the selected output length.
requirements.behavior: Creates a zero-filled Key, all-ones V, then applies Update to seed material.

requirements.requirement: HMAC_DRBG_Update performs the 0x00 round and the conditional 0x01 round in order.
requirements.behavior: Updates Key then V for both rounds and omits the second round when provided_data is empty.

requirements.requirement: Seed material is entropy_input || nonce || personalization_string.
requirements.behavior: Concatenates exact byte spans in normative order without conversion or truncation.

requirements.requirement: Requested strength is supported and entropy/nonce input lengths meet the selected profile.
requirements.behavior: Accepts 128/192/256, enforces entropy bytes >= strength/8 and nonce bytes >= strength/16; production uses SHA-256/256 with 48 and 32 bytes.
residualAssumptions: Input byte length does not establish source min-entropy.
Only the SHA-256/256 profile is selected in the canonical production provider.

requirements.requirement: Reseed updates state from fresh entropy and additional input, then sets reseed_counter to 1.
requirements.behavior: Enforces minimum input, concatenates entropy and additional input, updates Key/V, and resets the counter; production obtains a fresh 48-byte buffer.
residualAssumptions: OS API success is trusted for freshness and entropy quality.

requirements.requirement: Generate rejects when reseed_counter exceeds the interval.
requirements.behavior: Allows entry at 2^48, increments after success, and rejects the next request.

requirements.requirement: Generate applies optional pre-update, repeated HMAC(Key,V), post-update, and counter increment in order.
requirements.behavior: Implements the normative ordering and passes continuation vectors.

requirements.requirement: One Generate request returns no more than 2^19 bits.
requirements.behavior: Rejects non-positive counts and counts above 65,536 bytes before state mutation.

requirements.requirement: Errors return no partial output and do not create an accepted DRBG result.
requirements.behavior: Generate zeroes its output on exception and the production wrapper destroys the session and fails closed.
residualAssumptions: A non-canonical direct caller must not reuse a session after a state-transition exception.

requirements.requirement: DRBG internal state is protected and destroyed when no longer needed.
requirements.behavior: Key/V are internal, per-session, and best-effort zeroed; canonical execution always destroys the session.
residualAssumptions: .NET managed memory and platform crypto internals cannot guarantee physical erasure.
One direct Generate V replacement should zero the replaced array.

requirements.requirement: DRBG instances do not share mutable state across requests.
requirements.behavior: Every authoritative draw creates and destroys its own session; runtime and sampler singletons are stateless.

requirements.requirement: Prediction resistance is implemented only when the defined request semantics are supported.
requirements.behavior: Per-draw instantiate/reseed is used, but formal prediction resistance is not claimed.
residualAssumptions: Claims and external materials must retain the explicit non-claim.

requirements.requirement: Known-answer tests demonstrate the selected mechanism's deterministic behavior.
requirements.behavior: Runs deterministic SHA-2 regression vectors and NIST CAVS 14.3 HMAC_DRBG SHA-256 PR=False COUNT=0 at readiness.
residualAssumptions: Internal vector execution is not CAVP or CMVP validation.

requirements.reference: SP 800-90A Rev. 1, implementation health testing boundary
requirements.requirement: Catastrophic repetition is detected and fails closed in the selected implementation policy.
requirements.behavior: Compares consecutive generated HMAC blocks in fixed time and throws on repetition.
residualAssumptions: This application control is not a substitute for SP 800-90B entropy-source health tests.

requirements.requirement: Entropy-source min-entropy and health behavior are validated at the source boundary.
requirements.codeEvidence: AutoOsEntropyProvider platform API wrappers and readiness checks.
requirements.behavior: Requests cryptographic OS bytes and fails closed, but does not characterize min-entropy or validate the physical source.
residualAssumptions: Platform entropy source and validated module evidence are external dependencies.

requirements.requirement: The complete RBG construction has a defined, validated entropy and DRBG module boundary.
requirements.codeEvidence: Per-draw OS entropy -> HMAC_DRBG -> bounded sampler architecture.
requirements.behavior: Structurally resembles RBG2, but entropy and formal module-boundary evidence are incomplete.

requirements.requirement: Exactly one manifest-bound provider executes and no fallback can create an outcome.
requirements.behavior: Exact provider/version/config resolution; Official and Manual missing evidence rejects without CSPRNG fallback.

requirements.requirement: The authoritative result is exactly once, immutable, replayable, and certificate bound.
requirements.behavior: Durable claim, append-only attempts/evidence, exact certificate hash/signing binding, persisted retry, and settlement handoff passed QA.
residualAssumptions: Canceled pre-commit attempts can lack a terminal attempt row.

requirements.requirement: Bounded integers avoid modulo bias and use a fixed byte order.
requirements.behavior: Uses 64-bit rejection sampling, explicit big-endian interpretation, and modulo only after acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Keno/Matrix selection is uniform, bounded, and duplicate-free; Pick preserves positions and replacement.
requirements.behavior: Uses partial Fisher-Yates for no-replacement products and independent array positions for replacement products.
